messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER - routing-service: elevated 5xx and 429s observed across eu-west cluster. alert-id=rtg-1836 :warning:
Maria Gomez: seeing ~18% 5xx and p95 latency spiking to 1200ms for standard tier in eu-west. lots of queued requests on gpu-pool-2.
Sandeep Rao: confirmed. queue depth on router-2 -> gpu-pool-2 increased x4 in last 5m. throughput still up but backend tail latency bad.
Maria Gomez: impacting both generation and embeddings for standard tier. premium tier mostly healthy.
ops-bot: Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/routing-steer. Suggested play: 1) apply tiered steering 2) throttle low-priority 3) inform CS.
Leo Chen: proposal: smart-routing gate - prioritize premium to low-latency variants, shift standard to quantized cost-optimized models, steer some eu-west standard traffic to us-west spillover until pools recover.
Anya Patel: +1. tradeoff: cost up and some quality risk on quantized models but acceptable short-term. need to record eval set hits. :memo:
Maria Gomez: applying a fast policy now. command:```bash
redwoodctl routing apply --policy smart-tier-gate \ 
  --set "premium:route=lowlatency-v2;standard:route=quantized-v1;standard:spill=us-west:0.35" \ 
  --reason "eu-west spike - emergency steering"
```
oncall-bot: Incident channel note created. Severity P1->P2 depending on impact. page-team: eng-runtime, eng-sre.
ops-bot: policy accepted and pushed to router-2 (deploy id: deploy-1836123478). propagation ~30s.
Maria Gomez: quick metrics snapshot after change (1m window):```text
- p95 latency (standard eu-west): 1200ms -> 420ms
- 5xx rate (standard eu-west): 18% -> 6%
- 429s (standard eu-west): 9% -> 2%
- spill to us-west: ~28% of standard requests
```
Sandeep Rao: 429s down, queue depth halved, GPU util still high but stable. cost estimate: +12% on billable tokens while steering active.
customer-ops-bot: Notifying CS for top impacted customers: AcmeApp, FinanceCo-EU, StudyAid-APAC. message posted to #customer-notifications.
Maria Gomez: Customer impact: AcmeApp saw timeouts on embedding endpoints around 18:12 UTC, FinanceCo had elevated latency for interactive chat, StudyAid saw increased inference latency for long prompts.
Leo Chen: For high-value customers (AcmeApp, FinanceCo) I'm bumping quota & pinning to premium lane temporarily. command:```bash
redwoodctl customers update-quota --customer AcmeApp --quota-burst 2x --route-pin premium
redwoodctl customers update-quota --customer FinanceCo --quota-burst 1.5x --route-pin premium
```
ops-bot: quota changes accepted. tokens re-routed, confirm with CS.
Anya Patel: Logging mitigation decision & expected rollback plan in incident doc. rollback plan: keep policy for 2 hours, then reduce spill by 10% every 30m while monitoring p95 & 5xx.
Sandeep Rao: I'll own the monitoring. will post 30m rollup and a final signoff before rollback.
Maria Gomez: Also turned off non-essential background batch requests for standard tier (feature-flag: standard-batch-autosend=false) to reduce pressure.
oncall-bot: Handoff: @Maria off at 20:00 UTC. @Leo taking watch for next 2h. Please escalate back if >5% 5xx or p95 >800ms.
Leo Chen: ack. will watch dashboards and logs. setting alert threshold lower for the next 2h.
Anya Patel: please capture any regression for quality monitoring - if quantized variants exceed eval-error thresholds, abort steering.
Sandeep Rao: 30m check-in in ~25m. current metrics look stable.
Maria Gomez: filing incident summary draft now: https://incidents.redwood.internal/1836123456 - will add CS notes.
customer-ops-bot: CS notified: messages queued to customers with mitigation steps and ETA for rollback.
Leo Chen: If everything stays green at the 2h mark we'll ramp down spill over 1h window. posting timeline to channel.
oncall-bot: NOTE: incident status -> mitigated. Monitoring continues. If regressions occur, re-open and escalate. :white_check_mark:
